eps.ov: Ashito finally gets the promotion to the A team, and he does everything he can to keep up. However...
When Taira and Matsunaga invite Ashito and the others to dinner, Kuribayashi appears and joins them.

eps.t: Premier League Match 7 – Kashiwa Dai Business School
eps.ov: Ashito makes the A team's roster for the Premier League for the match against Kashiwa Dai Business School.
Ashito fails to keep up with the pace of the Premier League, and Kashiwa identifies him as a weak spot.
Kuribayashi's presence overwhelms Ashito, but he notices something unusual about Kuribayashi's play.
Kobayakawa returns from injury. Faced with obvious skill gap with the starters, Togashi takes action.
Fukuda suggests a drill with ropes at the nighttime practice. Then, Kuribayashi gives a notebook to Ashito.
